lace.gui.screen.config.main.title: Lace Settings
Hides forced resource and data packs from the selection menu.
lace.gui.screen.config.main.warn-enabled: Enables/disables the warning screen when there are invalid dependencies. Don't disable this unless you're okay with users skipping pack downloads.
lace.gui.screen.config.main.prompt-enabl: Enables/disables the reload prompt that shows after successfully downloading dependencies. If disabled, the game will automatically reload.
lace.gui.screen.config.main.disable-comp: Enables/disables Minecraft's version compatibility warnings for dependency packs.
lace.gui.screen.config.main.button-offse: Moves the title screen button. Useful if it's overlapping with another mod's button.
lace.gui.screen.config.dependencies.edit: The first slug to query hosts for.
Back-up slugs to search with if the primary slug fails.
Website(s) to attempt to download this dependency from.
How this dependency should be loaded into the game.
The dependency is forced enabled. Uses loading priority to determine order. Always loads below optional packs, regardless of priority.
The dependency is enabled by default, but can be disabled. Uses loading priority to determine order.
The dependency is disabled by default, but can be enabled.
The dependency is not loaded, only downloaded to support the authors.
Determines where this dependency loads relative to other dependencies. Higher priority = higher in the pack list.
